location_exception_reason: Log homes are destination-driven products where geographic origin (hill-station, eco-region, proximity to tourist zones) materially influences buyer decision-making and property value. Location in title signals authentic regional positioning for resort/eco-tourism buyers.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Builder') are redundant in log home titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing these words leaves the product description complete and accurate.
